final:
def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format Unix timestamp ts (seconds) as zero-padded UTC HH:MM:SS, 24 hours."""
    pre ts >= 0
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
    ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
    secs = ts % 86400
    h = secs // 3600
    m = (secs % 3600) // 60
    s = secs % 60
    return f"{h // 10}{h % 10}:{m // 10}{m % 10}:{s // 10}{s % 10}"
